scientific_integrity: All four expected cover times are exact rational solutions of finite linear systems, corroborated through independent hitting-time inclusion-exclusion. No independent scientific validation or authorship claim is made.
scientific_limitations: An explicit pair of eleven-vertex trees establishes only radius-one, fixed-start, equal-order sign nonlocality under a single edge insertion; minimal order, higher radii, and all-orders versions remain unproved. The motivating manuscript abstract was accessible, but its full text was not; priority cannot be certified.
title: Equal-order radius-one nonlocality of random-walk cover-time response on trees
